Begin bij de beginnersmethode als je nog: Start with the beginner's method if you can't solve the cube yet. If you can, F2L is the next step, followed by OLL and PLL. Every diagram on this page is drawn from the algorithm underneath it, so what you see always matches what you do.
Je lost de kubus laag voor laag op: eers: You solve the cube layer by layer: the white side first, then the middle layer, then the yellow side. You only need a handful of moves. From step 3 on, always hold the cube with white on the bottom and yellow on top.
Een letter is een kwartslag met de klok: A letter is a quarter turn of that face, clockwise as seen from that side. R is right, L left, U up, D down, F front and B back. An apostrophe means counterclockwise (R') and a 2 means a half turn (R2). That's all there is to it.
Zoek de vier randen met wit en leg ze al: Find the four edges with white on them and place them in a cross around the white centre. Watch the second colour: it has to line up with the centre of that side. So a white and green edge belongs next to the green centre. You do this by feel, without an algorithm; keep trying until it works.
Turn the cube over so white is on the bottom. Find a corner with white in it, move it above the spot where it belongs, then repeat:
Hooguit zes keer en de hoek valt vanzelf: At most six times and the corner drops into place. If a white corner sits in the bottom layer the wrong way round, do this once to pop it out and start again. These four moves are called the sexy move; you'll see them everywhere.
Zoek in de bovenste laag een rand <em>zo: Find an edge in the top layer without yellow. Turn the top so its front colour matches the centre below it, and see which way it needs to go:
naar rechts: U R U' R' U' F' U F: to the right: U R U' R' U' F' U F
naar links: U' L' U L U F U' F': to the left: U' L' U L U F U' F'
Zit een rand op de goede plek maar verke: Is an edge in the right spot but flipped? Do either of the two to take it out, then put it back the right way.
Nu alleen de bovenkant nog. Je ziet een: Only the top is left. You'll see a dot, an L shape or a line of yellow. These six moves take you one step further each time, until you have a cross:
Bij een haakje houd je hem linksboven, b: Hold an L shape in the top left and a line horizontally. With a dot it doesn't matter; you'll need it three times.
Houd een hoek die nog niet geel is recht: Hold a corner that isn't yellow yet at the front right and repeat:
Draai <em>alleen de bovenste laag</em> n: Turn only the top layer to bring the next wrong corner to the front right and do it again. In between the cube looks scrambled; that's expected, it'll come back. This algorithm is called the Sune and is case 27 in OLL.

Staat er geen enkel paar goed, doe het d: If no pair is right, do it once and look again.
Nog drie randen te draaien. Houd de rand: Three edges left to cycle. Hold the edge that's already right at the back and do:
Klopt het nog niet? Dan draaien ze de an: Still not right? Then they cycle the other way: do it twice. This is the Ua perm; you'll find it in PLL as well.
Zo kom je met zeven stappen rond. Wil je: That's the whole cube in seven steps. To get faster, replace steps 2 and 3 with F2L (corner and edge together), steps 4 and 5 with OLL (the whole top yellow at once) and steps 6 and 7 with PLL (the top layer solved at once). That's the CFOP method, and it's in the other tabs.
Bij de beginnersmethode zet je eerst all: In the beginner's method you place all the white corners first and then the middle-layer edges. F2L does both at once: you find a corner and the edge that goes next to it, pair them up on top, and insert the pair into its slot in one go. Four pairs, four slots, and your first two layers are done.
Het idee is belangrijker dan de lijst. A: The idea matters more than the list. Everything below comes down to three things:
<strong>Zit het paar al aan elkaar?</str: Is the pair already joined? Then move it above the right slot with U and insert it with R U R' or F' U' F.
<strong>Zitten hoek en rand los van elka: Are the corner and edge apart? Bring them together first. That's almost always: open a slot, turn the edge next to the corner, and close the slot again.
<strong>Zit er al iets in de sleuf?</str: Is something already in the slot? Take it out with R U R' and treat it as a normal case. That costs a few extra moves, but there's nothing extra to memorise.
